sloka: तत्र त्वम् चैव मे न अस्ति रामः च वनम् आश्रितः ।न वनम् गन्तुम् इच्चामि सर्वथा हि हता त्वया ॥२-६१-२५॥
transliteration: tatra tvam caiva me na asti rāmaḥ ca vanam āśritaḥ ।na vanam gantum iccāmi sarvathā hi hatā tvayā ॥2-61-25॥

translations.english: Such Rama, the best among men, powerful like a lion, with eyes fierce like that of a bull has been destroyed by his own father just as the big fish destroys its own offsprings.
translations.hindi: यदि में लाल नेत्र वाले, महाबाहु और रत्नकुण्डलधारी राम को न दैखूँगा; ता में यमालय का चला जाऊँगा अर्थात मर जाऊंगा
